steps.en: REPCCS sends each notice live and OCMS takes it in immediately
steps.id: REPCCS mengirim tiap notice secara langsung dan OCMS langsung menerimanya

steps.en: Incoming notice data is checked before it is accepted
steps.id: Data notice yang masuk diperiksa dulu sebelum diterima

steps.en: A Notice of Parking Offence is saved as a new notice
steps.id: Notice of Parking Offence disimpan sebagai notice baru

steps.en: An Advisory Notice is recognised and kept as one that cannot be paid
steps.id: Advisory Notice dikenali dan disimpan sebagai notice yang tidak bisa dibayar
steps.why_en: Advisory flag and payment block are saved, but no advisory suspension is created for REPCCS notices.
steps.why_id: Flag advisory dan blok bayar tersimpan, tetapi suspension advisory tidak dibuat untuk notice dari REPCCS.

steps.en: A notice for unauthorised parking lot use, without a vehicle number, is saved
steps.id: Notice penggunaan parking lot tanpa izin, tanpa nomor kendaraan, disimpan

steps.en: A saved notice gets its first processing step so work can start
steps.id: Notice yang tersimpan diberi langkah proses pertama supaya kerja bisa mulai

steps.en: Every receipt is recorded and REPCCS is told the result at once
steps.id: Setiap penerimaan dicatat dan REPCCS langsung diberi tahu hasilnya
steps.why_en: Rejections during notice creation are replied to REPCCS but not marked failed in the record, so reports miss them.
steps.why_id: Penolakan saat pembuatan notice dibalas ke REPCCS tetapi tidak ditandai gagal di catatan, jadi report tidak memuatnya.
